models.name: Research Open Office From Floor Plan

assumptions: Scale is derived from the visible 4500 mm, 1910 mm, and 1710 mm dimensions at approximately 35 pixels per meter.
The screenshot is cropped; the visible envelope is represented as a 20.6 m by 14.4 m rectangle centered at the model origin.
The plan label says 30 people, while 32 L-shaped workstation outlines are visibly identifiable; all 32 visible workstations are modeled.
The dense repeated mullions on the south, east, and west facades are interpreted as continuous full-height glass curtain walls.

The open-office desks have perpendicular main and return branches and are modeled as lShapedOfficeDesk components; screenHeight is assumed to be the skill default of 0.55 m because no elevation is provided.
Circular plan symbols are modeled as round pillars and round coffee tables; the general manager coffee table and all backless sofas are rectangular.
Door swings, cabinet internals, and small equipment are simplified to RoomSpace primitives.
Ceiling height is not labeled and is assumed to be 3.0 m; wall thickness is assumed to be 0.18 m.
